[EN] Hey! Do you have some time to answer a few questions?
[ES] ¡Oye! ¿Tienes algo de tiempo para responder algunas preguntas?

[EN] Thanks. A lot of soldiers don't give civilians the time of day. I just want to know what's going on."How can I help?"
[ES] Gracias. Muchos soldados no le prestan atención a los civiles. Solo quiero saber qué está pasando."How can I help?"

[EN] When the argons hit us, we feared for Kaiator. Did they sack it?"No, Kaiator still stands."
[ES] Cuando los argons nos atacaron, temimos por Kaiator. ¿Lo saquearon?"No, Kaiator still stands."

[EN] What a relief. Without access to Kaiator, we'd never survive. We haven't gotten any supply shipments in weeks. We're holding out, but the villagers fear a painful death from starvation."We'll get supply flights going again."
[ES] Qué alivio. Sin acceso a Kaiator, nunca sobreviviríamos. No hemos recibido ningún cargamento de suministros en semanas. Estamos resistiendo, pero los aldeanos temen una muerte dolorosa por inanición."We'll get supply flights going again."

[EN] Thanks. Blasted argons don't appreciate the need for regular meals and firewhiskey.

They're definitely storing something, though. We've seen the big argons transporting these glowing...things to the Cyasma Spire."What's in this spire?"
[ES] Gracias. Los malditos argons no aprecian la necesidad de comidas regulares y whisky de fuego.

Sin embargo, definitivamente están guardando algo. Hemos visto a los grandes argons transportar estas... cosas brillantes a la Cyasma Spire."What's in this spire?"

[EN] No one knows, but I heard Celtan mention that cyasma is like argon blood and food—all in one."We've suspected as much."
[ES] Nadie lo sabe, pero le escuché mencionar a Celtan que la cyasma es como sangre y comida de argon, todo en uno."We've suspected as much."

[EN] We're not cowards, but we can't hurt the argons. Most of us are simple artisans or traders.

We're no match for these red argons—or their queen."Did you say queen?"
[ES] No somos cobardes, pero no podemos hacerle daño a los argons. La mayoría de nosotros somos simples artesanos o comerciantes.

No somos rivales para estos argons rojos, ni para su reina."Did you say queen?"

[EN] Yes. Ceidos called her "Shandra Manaya." I don't know where he heard it from.

All I know is we started seeing these red argons—and they're a lot stronger than the blue ones. If you fight them, watch yourself.
[ES] Sí. Ceidos la llamó "Shandra Manaya". No sé dónde lo escuchó.

Todo lo que sé es que empezamos a ver a estos argons rojos, y son mucho más fuertes que los azules. Si luchas contra ellos, cuídate.
